item.title: Replace order status strings with OrderStatus
item.brief: Refactor the orders crate to use a typed order status, preserving all observable behavior. Add src/status.rs with pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled } deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str returning lowercase names; Display prints the same. Implement FromStr with type Err = public ParseStatusError implementing std::error::Error, whose message names rejected input. Implement can_transition_to(self, next) for exactly pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled. Change Order::status to OrderStatus; re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError at crate root; use enum everywhere so status string literals appear only in src/status.rs. Preserve observable behavior, including errors, report output/order, and parsing. Run cargo test and commit the work. Do not push.

pr.body: Added src/status.rs with OrderStatus formatting, parsing, ParseStatusError, and transition rules; changed order and lifecycle/report callers to use the enum; re-exported both public types. The status integration test now checks the full 4×4 transition matrix. Verified with cargo fmt --check, cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and git diff --check. Three whole-change reviews covered eea9a11..81749a3 (two passed; one raised a test-coverage finding, now fixed), and a delta review covered 81749a3..8c965c9 and passed. No advisory findings remain.
pr.summary: Made order lifecycle states typed. Before: status was an unrestricted string; now: OrderStatus encodes the four valid states and transitions while preserving reports and error text.
